prior.note: debugCouldLogPasscode (plan L265-L269) splits DEBUG on whitespace and commas. It refuses any non-negated pattern that contains * or starts with pw, and any non-empty DEBUG_FILE or PWDEBUG. parseLiveArgs calls it (L274). The tests at L128-L134 cover pw:api, *, pw*, foo,*, vite:*, 'express pw:protocol', DEBUG_FILE and PWDEBUG. They also cover the allowed values '', express, vite:config, -pw:* and -*. I traced each case through the predicate and it gives the expected result. The Global Constraint (L22) and gates step 5 match the code.

clip redacts and then slices (L305-L307). It is used for request failures, with [o.passcode, ...secrets], where secrets is declared at L322 before the closure runs. It is also used for page errors (L725), the Firefox launch error (L754) and the entry's message() (L974, L984, L1010). secretVariants adds JSON.stringify(s).slice(1,-1) (L298). I traced both tests by hand. The quote case gives {"failure":"x [redacted] y"} through the JSON-escaped variant. The 695+passcode case gives 'x'*695+'[reda'.

The pure playStep (L634-L651) is used by the loop at L784-L787. An early end needs both sides ended, the first end at or after MIN_EARLY_END_MS, and the second within END_AGREE_MS. A one-sided end against a non-running phase, a timeout, a 'came back from ended', and any other phase all fail. I traced every playStep test at L511-L532 and each gives the expected result. validateLiveReport re-checks both rules (L947-L948), and the tests are at L872-L877. playedMs (L792) is at least the first-ended time, so the report floor agrees with playStep.

compareDeployedVersion (L310-L314) deep-compares the live version.json with the local file. It returns versionCompared:false when the file is absent. When the file exists, a null live version or a mismatch is a problem. The entry calls it with resolve('.vercel/output/static/version.json') (L998-L1000). build-web.ts:L16-L20 confirms the production build writes static/version.json under .vercel/output. The tests (L206-L217) cover absent, equal, a differing digest and null. The LiveReport type and the passing() fixture carry versionCompared.

The dry run at L1051 uses https://ftlite-dry-run.invalid, and the expected text explains the DNS failure. Header problems throw before compareDeployedVersion runs, so a .vercel/output left in the worktree cannot change the result.
TAKE_DOWN (L976-L977) and gates step 6 (L1095-L1098) give delete as the first-deploy action (npx vercel rm <url> --yes, or Dashboard delete) and rollback for later deploys. L-8 (L37) matches.

FIREFOX_MISSING (L690) is checked against the launch error (L752-L756). bounded (scripts/web/net/players.ts:L43-L47) passes the original rejection through unchanged, so Playwright's 'Executable doesn't exist … npx playwright install' text reaches the regex. Any other error throws, with its text clipped. L-7 (L36) matches.

Early-end sampling: the first relay sample is taken at began (L775) and the second at began+10 s. An early end that playStep accepts (first end ≥ 20 s) therefore has at least two samples for relayVerdict. A missing sample can only make the run fail, never pass falsely.

Whether real host and guest pages read 'ended' within END_AGREE_MS of each other when one loop tick includes a sample() of up to about 12 s. A slow tick could fail a genuinely finished round. This would be a spurious failure only, and I could not check it without a live run.
